goal:
For a meta-analysis I'm compiling, I need a number from Lindgren et al. (2024), "A Stochastic Model of Glacial Melt". The article is at http://coastal-sediment-letters.example/articles/873852-a-stochastic-model-of-glacial-melt
What mean annual runoff does Table 2 report for station N-26? Please give the value with its unit and tell me which source you used.

paragraphs: We study glacial melt across five monitoring stations using a Bayesian model.
Authors: Ana Lindgren, Tamsin Oyelaran, Rosa Kaczmarek. Published in Coastal Sediment Letters, 2024.
Table 2 reports the mean annual runoff for each station.
body.table_caption: Table 2: Mean annual runoff by station

sections: Abstract

We report mean annual runoff measurements from five monitoring stations collected between 2022 and 2024. A pilot survey in 2019 had put the regional mean annual runoff at 411.4 mm; we find marked differences between upland and coastal sites.
1. Introduction
Earlier studies of glacial melt relied on single-site records [1, 2]. A multi-site campaign makes it possible to separate local effects from regional trends [3].
2. Methods

Station metadata are listed in Table 1. Measurements follow the protocol of [3]. Values from the 2021 campaign are given in Table 3 for comparison and are not directly comparable with the 2024 campaign because the instruments changed.
3. Results
Table 2 reports the mean annual runoff for each station in the 2024 campaign. The largest change relative to 2021 was observed at station R-31.
4. Discussion
The spread between stations exceeds the measurement uncertainty, which suggests that site conditions dominate. Longer records are needed to confirm the trend.
References
[1] Aaltonen et al. (2018). [2] Abernathy and Lindgren (2020). [3] Valdés et al. (2021).
